subject.title: fix(fal): apply request policy to media generation requests

question: Is the controlled FAL-compatible localhost provider-path proof sufficient for this private-network and transport-policy change, or must the contributor provide redacted real FAL or representative proxy/private-endpoint proof?
rationale: The patch follows the established explicit opt-in contract and has no remaining correctness finding, but repository policy requires live testing for external API work and the supplied evidence does not exercise the real external transport path.

options.title: Require representative network proof
options.body: Keep merge blocked until redacted evidence exercises real FAL or a representative proxy/private-network route across the affected media scope.

options.title: Accept controlled provider proof
options.body: Explicitly accept the current full provider-path transcript because the change only connects the canonical sanitized resolver and its security defaults are covered by source and tests.

recommendation.title: Require representative network proof
recommendation.body: Keep merge blocked until redacted evidence exercises real FAL or a representative proxy/private-network route across the affected media scope.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current shared request transport contract and FAL media helper whose intended private-network scope determines the appropriate proof bar.
